customer_message.subject: Telephone note – Bergstrasse 120, Kriens, possible termination
customer_message.body:
Call from Mr Felix Bianchi, tenant of a 5.5-room flat at Bergstrasse 120 in Kriens; landlord Verwaltung Emme & Söhne.

Mr Bianchi explains that he is CHF 4880 behind with the rent (two months) after an accident and a long period on sick pay. He says he received an e-mail from the management last week stating that "the tenancy will be ended" on 31 July 2027 because of the outstanding rent.

He is unsure whether this e-mail is a valid termination or whether the management has actually issued one yet; he has not received a letter or a form by post, and the e-mail does not have a signature. He asked whether an e-mail can be a termination at all.

He wants to keep the flat and is prepared to pay the arrears by instalments.

I advised him to send us the e-mail. Callback agreed for tomorrow.
